title: Sliding Mode Observer
text: Compute electrical position and mechanical speed of a surface-mount PMSM, 5 inputs, 2 outputs, {Speed unit} sets Unit of speed output; {Input units} sets the unit of block inputs, {Discrete step size (s)} sets the sample time after which block executes again, {Stator resistance (ohm)} sets the resistance, {Stator inductance (H)} sets the inductance 0.2e-3, {Maximum application speed (RPM)} sets the maximum supported mechanical speed, {Number of pole pairs}, {Base voltage (V)} sets the nominal voltage corresponding to one per, {Base current (A)} sets the nominal current corresponding to one per, {Back-emf observer gain} sets the sliding mode observer gain for back-emf, {Current observer gain} sets the sliding mode observer gain for current, {Filter cut-off frequency (Hz)} sets the cut-off frequency of internal filter, {Position unit} sets the unit of position, {Position data type} sets the data type of position and {Speed data type} sets the data type of speed. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Input units
params.values: Unit of block inputs SI unit (default) | Per-unit

params.name: Discrete step size (s)
params.values: Sample time after which block executes again 50e-6 (default) | scalar

params.name: Number of pole pairs
params.values: Number of pole pairs available in motor 4 (default) | scalar

params.name: Base voltage (V)
params.values: Nominal voltage corresponding to one per unit 13.8564 (default) | scalar

params.name: Base current (A)
params.values: Nominal current corresponding to one per unit 21.4286 (default) | scalar

params.name: Back-emf observer gain
params.values: Sliding mode observer gain for back-emf 0.9 (default) | scalar

params.name: Current observer gain
params.values: Sliding mode observer gain for current 0.50881 (default) | scalar

params.name: Filter cut-off frequency (Hz)
params.values: Cut-off frequency of internal filter 1200 (default) | scalar

params.name: Position unit
params.values: Unit of position output Radians (default) | Degrees | Per unit

params.name: Position data type
params.values: Data type of position output single (default) | double | fixed point

params.name: Speed unit
params.values: Unit of speed output RPM (default) | Degrees/sec | Radians/sec | Per unit

params.name: Speed data type
params.values: Data type of speed output single (default) | double | fixed point
